title: Pezeshkian meets Putin as Trump pitches diplomacy
gist: Al-Monitor's Middle East Minute podcast blurb reports that Saudi authorities said three people were killed in attacks on the Riyadh airport, and that US President Donald Trump said he will not attack Iran before the November midterm elections, as Iran's Pezeshkian meets Putin.

insights.claim: Saudi authorities reported that three people were killed in attacks on the Riyadh airport.
insights.so_what: Direct attacks on Saudi capital infrastructure raise Gulf risk premia for oil, aviation and regional assets.
insights.quote: Saudi authorities said three people were killed in attacks on the Riyadh airport
insights.locator: Pezeshkian meets Putin as Trump pitches diplomacy
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor

insights.claim: US President Donald Trump said he will not attack Iran before the November midterm elections, signalling a pause in US military action tied to the domestic political calendar.
insights.so_what: Pushes the window for a US strike on Iran past the midterms, shaping the timing of oil-price tail risk.
insights.quote: US President Donald Trump said he will not attack Iran before the November midterm elections
insights.locator: Pezeshkian meets Putin as Trump pitches diplomacy
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor

insights.claim: Iranian President Pezeshkian met Russian President Putin while Trump was pitching diplomacy with Iran, showing Tehran deepening ties with Moscow in parallel with US outreach.
insights.so_what: Russia-Iran alignment can reduce the leverage of US diplomacy and sanctions on Iran.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
